title: Albumin–creatinine context does not improve serum urate prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A prespecified albumin-by-log-creatinine interaction did not improve serum urate prediction beyond additive nonlinear renal and metabolic measures: source PSU-grouped cross-validation MSE reduction -0.001510; frozen transfer from 5,229 NHANES 2007–08 adults to 5,625 adults in 2009–10 gave reduction -0.001831 (mg/dL)², with two-sample refit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.008650, 0.010477]. This is a negative incremental-prediction result across independent cycles within one survey program, not equivalence, an external-program replication, or evidence against urate physiology.
